Description: Service to connect with auth controller

File: `src/posts/providers/posts.service.ts`

### UsersService

File: `src/users/providers/users.service.ts`

Description: Class to connet to Users table and make operations tasks

Methods:
- `findAll(limit: number, page: number): {}` — Method to get all users from the database
- `findByUserId(userId: string): { id: string; name: string; email: string; }` — Method to find specific user with id

## Classes

### CreatePostDto

File: `src/posts/dtos/create.post.dto.ts`

Description: Dto to create post

Properties:
- `content: string` — Content of a post
- `featureImgUrl?: string` — Feature Image for a post
- `publishOn?: string` — Publish date of a post
- `slug: string` — Slug for a post
- `status: string` — Status of a post
- `tags?: string[]` — Tags of a post
- `title: string` — Title for a post

### CreateUserDto

File: `src/users/dtos/create.user.dto.ts`

Description: DTO for full user Create.

Properties:
- `email: string` — Email of a user
- `firstname: string` — The firstname of a user
- `lastname?: string` — The lastname of a user
- `password: string` — Password of a user

### GetUserDto

File: `src/users/dtos/get.user.dto.ts`

Description: DTO for full user Get (Get).

Properties:
- `id: number` — The unique numeric ID of the user

### PatchPostDto

File: `src/posts/dtos/patch.post.dto.ts`
Extends: `PartialType(CreatePostDto)`

Description: Dto to update a post

Properties:
- `id: number` — Id to update a post

### PutUserDto

File: `src/users/dtos/put.user.dto.ts`
Extends: `PartialType(CreateUserDto)`

Description: DTO for full user update (PUT). All fields from CreateUserDto are optional.
